~ Untitled Discourse on Greed (1st)

“Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya satta dhammā bhāvetabbā. “Mendicants, for insight into greed, seven things should be developed. Katame satta? What seven? Satisambojjhaṅgo …pe… The awakening factor of mindfulness … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo—the awakening factor of equanimity. rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime satta dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti. These seven things should be developed for insight into greed.”
